visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro panel | image card | panel of numbered steps
notes: Intro panel | image card | lime panel of three numbered steps.

Full-width band with dark green (#0d5945) section background: left panel white heading and black "Know More" pill, centre earth image card, right lime-yellow panel with 3 numbered steps (Collect e-Waste, Drop-off, Contribute to Change).

contentPattern.structure: one row, three cells: (1) heading and Know More link; (2) image only; (3) numbered list of steps (each item a bold step title and text). The block numbers the steps
contentPattern.rows: one or more rows, same cell count
cells: one cell per column: text, images, links
reasons: Fixed set of different content side by side (intro, image, steps): Columns. The section is colored dark green (section style dark-green); the lime-yellow fill of the steps column is the block's own column styling.

usage: Sustainable Electronics (e-waste) section, section style dark-green.
reuseGuidance: Reuse columns-eco-steps wherever the same pattern appears (s21 (Sustainable Electronics): Intro (heading + Know More) | image | 3 numbered steps). Section styles seen: dark-green.
